raw_text: ISRO categorically denies any breach of its systems. 'Our telemetry, tracking and command networks are fully operational and secure. The claims and screenshots being circulated are entirely fabricated,' said ISRO spokesperson. CERT-In has confirmed no intrusion after detailed forensic review. All Indian satellite services including NavIC and GSAT continue to function normally.
clean_text: ISRO categorically denies system breach. Spokesperson confirms telemetry and command networks fully operational and secure. Claims and screenshots fabricated. CERT-In confirms no intrusion. All satellite services functioning normally.
